entities.summary: The Kōdōkan (弘道館) was the largest han school in Bakumatsu period Japan. Located in Mito, Ibaraki Prefecture, three of its buildings have been designated Important Cultural Properties and the school is a Special Historic Site. Kōdōkan is a museum in Asia, established in 1841. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
